Emergency stop flag controlled by pause/unpause.

ERC20 allowance mapping updated by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval/transferFrom.
Total Gold supply, increased by Gold.mint.

Per-player enemy combination, regenerated by createNewCombination.
Per-player play record storing seed, progress, units and rewards.
Dungeon cooldown period compared against block.timestamp.
Hero deployment cooldown passed to heroContract.deploy.
Private LCG randomness seed used by the dungeon random function.
List of mob class IDs sampled when generating new enemy combinations.
Owner-settable factor multiplying the level-up gold cost.
Library providing overflow-checked mul/div/sub/add used by ERC20 and ERC721 bookkeeping.

ERC20 transfer using SafeMath sub/add on balances.
ERC20 allowance-based transfer updating balances and allowed.

onlyCard abstract external reward-swap hook implemented by CryptoSagaCore.

Owner-only hero class definition writing heroClasses.

onlyAccessDeploy unchecked exp addition with an inline overflow sanity check.
onlyAccessDeposit unchecked increment of addressToGoldDeposit.
onlyOwnerOf level-up loop updating stats, exp and stored gold.
Pulls gold via external transferFrom then credits deposit.
Sends gold via external transfer then debits deposit.
Private pseudo-random generator seeding from blockhash and now.
Owner-only setter of the Gold contract address.
Owner-only depositAccess whitelist update.
Owner-only deployAccess whitelist update.
Owner-only mintAccess whitelist update.
Owner-only setter of the external swap contract address.
onlyAccessDeploy dungeon progress increment.
Main gameplay entry: validates tokens/cooldown, runs the battle simulation, applies rewards.
Computes exp/gold rewards, mints gold and calls heroContract.addExp.
Regenerates a personalized enemy combination using the random function.
Private LCG pseudo-random generator used for combat rolls.
Pure function that sorts the turn order by AGL.
Pure integer square root used in reward computation.
Private view validation of hero ownership and availability against now.
External call to an untrusted Gold contract inside transferDeposit before the deposit ledger is credited.
External call to an untrusted Gold contract inside withdrawDeposit before the deposit ledger is debited.

Raw += / -= on addressToGoldDeposit, currentExp, currentLevel and currentStats without SafeMath.

uint32 exponent (uint32(2)**32) and reward multiplications that can overflow or truncate.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner to authorize transferOwnership.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender with pendingOwner to authorize claimOwnership.
ERC721 transfer relies on msg.sender owning the token.
levelUp authorization and gold deduction are keyed on ownerOf(msg.sender's token).
transferDeposit builds an allowance call with msg.sender and credits addressToGoldDeposit[msg.sender].
withdrawDeposit debits addressToGoldDeposit[msg.sender] and refunds to msg.sender.
Gold.mint is gated by onlyAccessMint evaluated against msg.sender.
CryptoSagaCard.swap requires msg.sender to be the token owner before the external call.
enterDungeon uses msg.sender for progress, cooldown and reward accounting.
giveReward mints gold and exp rewards to msg.sender.
grantAccessDeposit is guarded by onlyOwner over msg.sender.
grantAccessDeploy is guarded by onlyOwner over msg.sender.
grantAccessMint is guarded by onlyOwner over msg.sender.
incrementProgressOfAddressAndId is gated by onlyAccessDeploy for msg.sender.
CryptoSagaHero.random mixes now into the seed state variable.
deploy sets availableAt from now plus duration and compares now with availableAt.
levelUp requires the hero's availableAt to be before now.
transferDeposit availability is influenced by the same timestamp-based cooldown state.
enterDungeon compares now against coolDungeon and the recorded play datetime.
The dungeon's random rolls depend on now-derived seed values.
enterDungeon stores now into addressToPlayRecordDateTime.
The LCG random function is seeded from timestamp-driven state.
pause flips the paused state variable to true.
unpause flips the paused state variable to false.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
claimOwnership writes the owner state variable.
ERC721 transfer delegates to clearApprovalAndTransfer.
takeOwnership delegates to clearApprovalAndTransfer.
clearApprovalAndTransfer calls addToken for the recipient.
clearApprovalAndTransfer calls removeToken for the sender.
_burn removes the token from the owner list.
approve writes the tokenApprovals state variable.
addToken pushes into ownedTokens and totalTokens.
removeToken mutates ownedTokens and ownedTokensIndex.
BasicToken.transfer updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
Gold.mint credits balances and totalSupply_.
CryptoSagaCard.mint loops over _mint.
CryptoSagaHero.mint calls the ERC721 _mint.
CryptoSagaCard.mint increments numberOfTokenId.
CryptoSagaHero.mint increments numberOfTokenIds.
mint derives IVs from timestamp-seeded randomness.
swap invokes the external swapContract before any local state is cleared or the card burned.
swap burns the card only after the external reward call returns.
swapCardForReward's onlyCard modifier checks cardAddess against msg.sender.
transferDeposit performs an external transferFrom before crediting the deposit ledger.
withdrawDeposit performs an external transfer before debiting the deposit ledger.
addExp performs unchecked exp addition and a truncating uint128 sanity check.
addDeposit performs unchecked += on addressToGoldDeposit.
levelUp performs unchecked level/exp/gold arithmetic and a stat recalculation loop.
enterDungeon calls giveReward on both win and loss paths.
enterDungeon calls createNewCombination after a cleared floor.
enterDungeon increments dungeon progress through the external progress contract.
enterDungeon deploys each participating hero via the external hero contract.
enterDungeon mints a dungeon chest card every 10th progress.
enterDungeon validates ownership and availability via a private helper.
The battle loop uses random for miss and critical rolls.
enterDungeon persists the assembled play record.
createNewCombination samples mobs using random.
giveReward calls the external heroContract.addExp for each hero.
giveReward mints gold rewards through the external Gold contract.
giveReward multiplies goldReward and truncates uint32(2)**32 expressions.
giveReward uses sqrt for reward scaling.
The dungeon random function updates the seed state variable.
The hero random function updates the seed state variable.
